messages.subject: Residual NAs
parts:
Hey everyone, 
I am trying to run an MC power analysis in which, in addition to a simple mediation model, the outcome is predicted by two additional variables. 
However, when trying to run the script below, the findFactorResidualVar function only returns NAs, does someone have a hint? 

install.packages("semTools")
install.packages("lavaan")
install.packages("simsem")
library(semTools)
library(lavaan)
library(simsem)



rejectMCCI <- function(object) {
  CIs <- semTools::monteCarloCI(object)
  apply(CIs, MARGIN = 1, function(CI) 0 < CI["ci.lower"] | 0 > CI["ci.upper"] )
}


N.per.group <- 10
nt <- rep(1:5, size = c(.1, .2, .4, .2, .1)*10)
et <- rep(1:5, size = c(.1, .2, .4, .2, .1)*10)
designMatrix <- expand.grid(NT = nt, ET = et)
designMatrix$age <-  sample(18:28, size = 25, replace = TRUE, prob = dnorm(18:28, mean = 23, sd = 2.5))
exoData <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:N.per.group, function(i)
  designMatrix))


a <- .5 # effect of NT on ADHD
b <- .3 # effect of ADHD ON ID
c <-.2 # effect of NT ID
d <- .2 # effect of ET on ID
e <- .3 # effect of age on ID


### Kappa matrix for exogenous paths
kappa.free <- kappa.pop <- matrix(NA, # estimate all effects
                                  nrow = 2, # 2 outcomes (M and Y)
                                  ncol = 3, # dummy coded X, W, XW
                                  dimnames = list(c("ADHD", "ID"),names(exoData)))

kappa.free["ADHD","NT"] <- "a"
kappa.free["ID","NT"] <- "c"
kappa.free["ID","ET"] <- "d"
kappa.free["ID","age"] <- "e"
kappa.free["ADHD","ET"] <- 0
kappa.free["ADHD","age"] <- 0


kappa.pop["ADHD","NT"] <- a
kappa.pop["ID","NT"] <- c
kappa.pop["ID","ET"] <- d
kappa.pop["ID","age"] <- e
kappa.pop["ADHD","ET"] <- 0
kappa.pop["ADHD","age"] <- 0


exoPaths <- bind(free = kappa.free, popParam = kappa.pop)


beta.free <- beta.pop <- matrix(0, nrow = 2, ncol = 2,
                                dimnames = list(c("ADHD","ID"), c("ADHD","ID")))

beta.free["ID","ADHD"] <- "b"
beta.pop["ID","ADHD"] <- b
endoPaths <- bind(free = beta.free, popParam = beta.pop)
exoCov <- cov.wt(exoData, method = "ML")$cov
exoCov <- exoCov + diag(0.02, ncol(exoCov))
(residVar <- findFactorResidualVar(beta = beta.pop, corPsi = diag(2),
                                  gamma = kappa.pop, covcov = exoCov))


(diag(residVar))
resEq <- binds(free = diag(as.numeric(NA), 2), popParam = diag(residVar))
